fields.definition: The delay the resilience policy waits before each retry of a transient error, computed from `RetryInterval` (default `250` ms) and the `RetryLengthening` (`SequenceLengthening`) strategy: `Lengthening` (`(2n - 1) * interval`, i.e., `1, 3, 5, 7... * interval`, the default; `Fibonacci` is retained as an `[Obsolete]` alias), `Linear` (`n * interval`), `HalfSquare` (`floor(n^2 / 2) * interval`, i.e., `0, 2, 4, 8, 12... * interval`, so the first retry is immediate), or `Squaring` (`2^(n - 1) * interval`, i.e., `1, 2, 4, 8, 16... * interval`). `RetryCount` (default `6`) caps the maximum number of retry attempts. All three settings participate in the connection configuration hierarchy.
fields.name: Retry backoff
